headline: Fullscreen / Live Chat
prompt:
Edit this existing VTuber editorial promotional tile, changing its main headline and making only minor layout adjustments needed for the new text. Preserve this illustration's original adult lavender-haired anime host, lavender/coral/near-black palette, modest dark streetwear, the lower-right illustrated game livestream and its chat + composer, and the polished cel-shaded editorial art. This is an original character and conceptual promotional UI, not an actual creator or real product screenshot.
Replace the old huge headline "Your stream." / "Your chat." completely with EXACTLY these two prominent lines:
"Fullscreen"
"Live Chat"
Critical spelling requirement: Fullscreen is ONE unbroken word, capital F then lowercase u l l s c r e e n. NEVER spell it "Full Screen". Second line is "Live Chat" (capital L and C, one space). These words are the main large campaign headline, not a tiny label. Use the same near-black heavy contemporary sans-serif type and make both lines effortlessly readable at220 x140thumbnail size. Keep sufficient padding, no cropped letters, do not collide with the face or frame.
Keep the top small label "LIVE CHAT FULLSCREEN" and the lower stage's three chat messages "LET'S GO", "So good!", "Love this" and input "Say something..." with send icon. No other new text.
Preserve image shape: chunky11:7 landscape rectangle, width-to-height1.5714, requested1760 x1120pixels. Do not output a panoramic banner. Recompose gently within this ratio if necessary; never stretch the artwork or crop typography. Keep the anime host on the left and headline on upper right. No official logos, new characters, shiny3D, physical monitors, or watermarks.
